slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Fairlight is Resolve's audio page for mix and delivery.
Normalize dialogue to -18 to -14 LUFS integrated for web.
High-pass at 80–100Hz on lavs to remove rumble.

slides.heading: DIALOGUE CHAIN
slides.caption: Dialogue clarity beats loud music every time.

slides.heading: WORKFLOW
steps: Normalize dialogue to web LUFS targets.
Limit the master bus to -1dB true peak.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Mix with monitors at conversation level—not blasted.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Over-compressing dialogue until it sounds robotic.
